item.title: Ki Pro Ultra 12G v2.8 firmware releases
item.description: AJA today released a new update for its Ki Pro Ultra 12G multi-channel 4K/UltraHD/HD recorder and player. The latest release includes important fixes and improvements, and users are encouraged to upgrade for optimal performance. Download free Ki Pro Ultra 12G v2.8 firmware now from the AJA Support Page.

item.title: Ring in the new year with AJA at events across the globe
item.description: Start the year off by visiting AJA at key industry events this month. Visit us at Hamburg Open, January 14-15 in Germany, to see live demos highlighting colour workflows, IP video, and more, and attend our on-site speaking session. The AJA team will also be out in full force at the Texas Film Gear Winter Showcase on January 15, and later in the month at the SVG Silicon Valley Video Summit on January 27. Explore these events and others on AJA’s events page.

item.title: Now available: BRIDGE LIVE 12G-4 and UDC-4K
item.description: BRIDGE LIVE 12G-4 and UDC-4K are now available for purchase through AJA's network of authorized resellers! A high-performance 12G-SDI and IP video solution, BRIDGE LIVE 12G-4 supports up to four channels of simultaneous 4K/UltraHD I/O. UDC-4K is an advanced Mini-Converter for 12G-SDI/HDMI 2.0 up/down/cross-conversion with frame sync and frame rate conversion capabilities. item.title: Explore AJA’s streaming solutions for live & on-demand video
item.description: Video streaming is ubiquitous, from social media and corporate communications to live sports, concerts, and even healthcare. The ways organizations deliver content continue to evolve, with more complex, multi-camera workflows and remote production setups becoming the norm. AJA’s new Streaming Solutions page provides a high-level overview of the technologies, protocols, formats, and codecs that make these experiences possible. Learn how adaptive bitrate streaming (ABR) improves viewer experiences

item.title: Discover AJA’s closed captioning solutions

AJA’s new Closed Captioning Solutions page launched today, providing an overview of the full workflow from caption creation and encoding to distribution and playback. item.title: MeyerPro helps keep Microsoft Ignite signals live with AJA
item.description: When AV Solutions Provider MeyerPro took on AV for the Microsoft Ignite conference in San Francisco, its team got to work quickly to architect and deploy a robust video infrastructure. Designed to support on-site and remote production needs for the event, the pipeline leveraged fiber conversion, frame sync, and recording technology from AJA. The setup helped ensure smooth production and live delivery of keynotes, technical sessions, and other event highlights to in-venue LED walls and audiences

item.title: Connect with AJA at industry events this February
item.description: ISE 2026 may have come to a close, but there will be more opportunities to connect with the AJA team at events throughout the month. Meet with us at the BSC Expo in London (13 Feb), followed by the DRI Technology Showcase in Arlington, TX (18 Feb), VMI’s Broadcast AV Showcase in Foster City, CA (24 Feb), and Key Code Media in Burbank, CA (25 Feb). Visit our events page for complete details on all the events we’re attending this month and find out how you can connect with the AJA team in-person.

item.title: AJA to Present Colour Pipelines Seminar at BSC Expo 2026
item.description: AJA is gearing up for BSC Expo 2026, where Andy Bellamy, EMEA Technical Director at AJA, will present a dedicated seminar exploring modern colour workflows for production and post. Join us on Friday, 13 February,at 5:00pm, for “Colour Pipelines for On-Set and Post-Production.” Focused on today’s evolving production and post pipelines for colour, the talk will provide practical insights into managing colour across contemporary workflows. Register now.

item.title: Uncover AJA’s AV solutions for medical workflows
item.description: AJA's technology is helping to facilitate broadcast-quality routing, monitoring, and recording in hospitals, telemedicine, simulation labs, and other medical environments. Find out how our solutions provide the reliability and long-term support that modern clinical and training workflowsdemand on our AV Solutions for Medical Workflows page.

item.title: Butcher Bird Studios builds production pipelines with AJA
item.description: From live-streamed events and virtual productions to immersive VR experiences, Butcher Bird Studios supports a range of technically demanding projects both from its Los Angeles facility and remotely. To keep pace with constantly evolving production requirements, the studio relies on AJA gear to deliver dependable signal routing, low-latency performance, and redundancy.
